intent: Two PR-time safety hardenings for CI. (1) Fix the Plumbline ci-evidence race: the Plumbline Gate finishes in ~15s while the Rust CI takes minutes, so its ci-evidence check races ahead and reports FAIL (required checks status=in_progress) on every first run. A 'Wait for required CI checks' step in plumbline.yml now polls both required checks ('Lint & Unit Tests', 'Release Gate — Catalog + Schema Invariants') to a terminal state before the gate runs, mirroring amos-protocol PR #2 (adapted from one check to two, matching this repo's ci_evidence_checks). (2) Add a Rails-style migration version-collision guard: parallel branches that hand-number migrations (YYYYMMDD000001) pick the same version and collide on merge, causing an sqlx checksum mismatch that crashes the harness on boot. A new 'Migration Version Guard' job in ci.yml (backed by .github/scripts/check-migration-order.sh, MIGRATIONS_DIR=amos-harness/migrations) fails any PR adding a migration whose version prefix is <= the latest on main. CLAUDE.md documents the sqlx migrate add convention. Workflow/CI/docs only; no src/ changes.

result_summary: Fixed the Plumbline ci-evidence race by adding a 'Wait for required CI checks' step to .github/workflows/plumbline.yml that polls 'Lint & Unit Tests' and 'Release Gate — Catalog + Schema Invariants' to a terminal state before the gate runs (mirror of amos-protocol PR #2, two checks instead of one). Added a Rails-style migration version-collision guard: new 'Migration Version Guard' job in .github/workflows/ci.yml backed by .github/scripts/check-migration-order.sh (MIGRATIONS_DIR=amos-harness/migrations), which fails any PR adding a migration whose version prefix is <= the latest on main. Documented the convention in CLAUDE.md. Verified: both workflows parse; the guard script passes bash -n; guard logic tested locally against real repo migrations (collide fails, higher passes) and a synthetic repo across all edge cases. Touches .github/workflows/** (protected) so self_modifying:true; the gate escalates to human review by design. Do not auto-merge.
